prose: A Business Insider report, per its sources: OpenEvidence, an AI search engine for doctors, raised $250 million at a $15 billion valuation - sharply up from a previous valuation in the low billions (the headline is truncated mid-figure). The captured text is site boilerplate only, so the headline is the evidence.

On that basis: OpenEvidence's raise signals continued investor appetite for vertical AI in medicine - a search and evidence tool aimed at clinicians rather than general consumers. Round participants and terms are not in the captured text.
